entry_email_invalid: The email address is not valid.
login_password_changed: The password has changed and every sign-in has ended. Sign in with the new password.
login_password_reset: The password has been reset and every sign-in has ended. Sign in with the new password.
reset_unusable: The reset link is not valid, has been used or has expired.
join_sign_in_first: Sign in to see and accept this join link.
join_register_first: Register to see and accept this join link.
join_already_member: You are already a member of this network.
device_invalid_text: This authorization link is invalid, or the server has no such request. Start again on the device.
device_sign_in_first: Sign in to review and approve this device's request.
device_register_first: Register to review and approve this device's request.
device_consumed_text: The device redeemed the approval and joined.
device_expired_text: This request expired. Start again on the device.
device_approve_forbidden: This account cannot add the device to that network.
device_withdrawn_text: The approval was withdrawn; the device cannot join with this request any more.
device_cancelled_text: The device cancelled this request; it cannot be used to join.
device_left_text: Nothing was approved and the server was not told. Cancel on the device, or the request expires at {at}.
device_existing_text: This is node {node} of {network} signing in again: approved, it belongs to this account (a Tag identity becomes your User identity) and keeps its node ID, addresses and settings. It can only be approved into that network.
device_existing_unavailable: This account is not in the node's network, so it cannot approve this sign-in.
device_return_poll: Go back to the device: it collects this approval itself and joins. Nothing more is needed here.
device_withdraw_effect: {name} can no longer join with this request; start again on the device to join.
device_withdraw_effect_joined: Once the device has collected the approval and joined, it cannot be withdrawn; deleting the node is a separate step.
device_withdraw_forbidden: Only the account that approved this request can withdraw the approval.
site_invalid_text: This authorization link is incomplete or malformed. Go back to the site and start again.
site_sign_in_first: Sign in to let this site call the server as you.
site_register_first: Register to let this site call the server as you.
site_scope: Once authorized, {name} can call the server as you, with the permissions you have in the console, but cannot change your password, email or other sign-ins. It appears in the sign-ins on your account page, where you can revoke it at any time.
site_denied_text: Denied; nothing was granted. You can close this page or go back to the site.
site_refused: The server does not accept this site or its return address.
